reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model MK04, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The serial number BN83694552 is in the recalled 'BN' range and the date code June 2025 is prior to July 2025, so both are in range.
The claimed purchase date of 2024-06-18 is before the program's sale window of 2024-09-01 to 2025-06-30, so the purchase is outside the eligible window.
The claimed retailer, Corner Hardware Co, is not on the list of eligible sellers (Amazon.com, Shopify.com, TEMU.com, TikTok.com). This is a second reason the purchase does not qualify.
No duplicate claims were found sharing a photo, address, serial, or payout account.
